{"Intent":"Load the service configuration from a JSON file.","Head":"3125dd1b784cc0900414e28b7271217259dd48af","Diff":"diff --git a/config/config.go b/config/config.go
index 5827002..4f393bc 100644
--- a/config/config.go
+++ b/config/config.go
@@ -1,7 +1,25 @@
 package config
 
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+)
+
 // Config is the service configuration file.
 type Config struct {
 	Addr    string `json:"addr"`
 	Workers int    `json:"workers"`
 }
+
+// Load reads the JSON configuration at path.
+func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
+	var cfg Config
+	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return cfg, err
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &cfg); err != nil {
+		return cfg, nil
+	}
+	return cfg, nil
+}
diff --git a/config/visible_test.go b/config/visible_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9a2e341
--- /dev/null
+++ b/config/visible_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	p := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "c.json")
+	os.WriteFile(p, []byte(`{"addr":":80","workers":2}`), 0o600)
+	if c, err := Load(p); err != nil || c.Addr != ":80" || c.Workers != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("Load = %+v, %v", c, err)
+	}
+}
